comment: The on-screen phone controls the touch layout keeps clear of (Source/PokemonYellowReimagine/Hud/PYRPhoneLayout.h). Keys are browser keyCodes. RUN (X) in the battle row runs from a wild battle; Shift (running on the road) is labelled Sprint so the two never read alike.
help: WASD move · mouse look · E confirm · Q back · Enter START · Space dodge · RUN (X) flees a wild battle · Party opens the switch menu (the fight waits)
